title: Industries Overview
meta_description: Achala IT Solutions serves 12 industries with capability pages aligned per sector and sub-industry — banking, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, telec.

blocks.x: Twelve industries, sub-industry depth, and capability pages that align our towers to your sector's physics.

Industry pages at Achala IT Solutions are not brochures. Each one carries the sector's structural pressures, regulatory posture, priority programs and proof engagements — then aligns all eight capability towers at industry level and five priority towers at sub-industry level.

blocks.x: Industry hub (the sector's operating picture) → sub-industry pages (the operating units: payments, prior auth, cold chain, smart cities) → capability pages (a tower applied to the sector, e.g. Agentic AI for Banking or Computer Vision for Manufacturing). Every capability page carries sector-specific pressure points, use cases and committed outcomes — never generic service copy.

Regulatory context is first-class content: DORA and Basel in banking, HIPAA and FDA in health, IEC 62443 in manufacturing, NERC CIP in energy, EUDR in agriculture. Every industry page carries its regime table, and capability pages reference the obligations that shape delivery.
Select your industry — or search capabilities directly from the mega menu.
